mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the revised rule on fresh Wednesday cases was most worthwhile: it showed the human handoff working on a different problem, not just the one that prompted the change.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the talkbox components was straightforward and less engaging than investigating the routing failure, though the listening signal was a useful detail.

surprise.text: The Tuesday test wrongly refused a two-carrier pickup because the rule could book only one volunteer; the request needed coordination, not rejection.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary; the repairs and tests had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the local dispatch system and its human safeguards hold up in practice; the testing sequence made those consequences interesting.
